## Why

Describe the problem this change solves. Link the related issue; use a closing keyword only when the issue is fully addressed.

## Changes

Describe the resulting behavior and any compatibility or safety implications.

## Validation

- [ ] Type check completed; existing warnings or failures explained
- [ ] Node build completed
- [ ] Tests completed; unverified checks explained
- [ ] Behavior changes have regression coverage
- [ ] UI changes include a screenshot or short recording with made-up notes

Include the checks run and their results. Describe any substantial AI assistance and how you reviewed it.
